esqlQuery.esql:
FROM seller-360
| EVAL profile_lag = CASE(`profile._meta.updated_at` >= NOW() - 10 minutes, DATE_DIFF("seconds", `profile._meta.source_ts`, `profile._meta.updated_at`), null), billing_lag = CASE(`billing._meta.updated_at` >= NOW() - 10 minutes, DATE_DIFF("seconds", `billing._meta.source_ts`, `billing._meta.updated_at`), null), offers_lag = CASE(`offers._meta.updated_at` >= NOW() - 10 minutes, DATE_DIFF("seconds", `offers._meta.source_ts`, `offers._meta.updated_at`), null)
| STATS profile_p99 = PERCENTILE(profile_lag, 99), billing_p99 = PERCENTILE(billing_lag, 99), offers_p99 = PERCENTILE(offers_lag, 99)
| WHERE profile_p99 > 300 OR billing_p99 > 300 OR offers_p99 > 300

documents.message: Lag sekcji seller-360 (profile, billing lub offers) przekroczył SLO 300 s (p99 w oknie 10 min)
